description: This file is the main application component for a to-do list web app built with React. It imports CSS styling, child components (Header, TodoForm, TodoList), and a custom hook (useTodos). The App component manages the rendering of the header, form, list, and error banner, utilizing the custom hook to manage to-do state and actions.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React component serving as application entrypoint; renders header, todo form, list, and error notifications.
